candidates.rationale: Its only observable result is the mutated slice contents, but current vstd contract handling materializes the final slice as unsized by-value `[u8]`; a useful elementwise lowercase relation therefore cannot be expressed and checked for this exact signature.

Its only observable result is the mutated slice contents, but current vstd contract handling materializes the final slice as unsized by-value `[u8]`; a useful elementwise uppercase relation therefore cannot be expressed and checked for this exact signature.

A useful contract must relate every final element to the corresponding reversed old element, but the exact mutable-slice receiver produces an unsized by-value `[T]` post-state that current vstd equality/view machinery cannot model here.

The source supports a rotation relation and the precondition `mid <= len`, but expressing the observable final contents of this exact `&mut [T]` receiver requires the unsupported unsized by-value `[T]` post-state.

The source supports a rotation relation and the precondition `k <= len`, but expressing the observable final contents of this exact `&mut [T]` receiver requires the unsupported unsized by-value `[T]` post-state.

A useful deterministic contract must model both the changed nested slice reference and whether `R` denotes a prefix or suffix split. Current vstd provides neither a usable post-state model for the unsized slice nor a public semantic abstraction for `OneSidedRange`, so a source-justified relation cannot be written.
